1.text: Yesu yongera kuvugana na bo abacira imigani ati

2.text: “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'umwami wacyujije ubukwe bw'umwana we arongora,

3.text: atuma abagaragu be guhamagara abatorewe gutaha ubukwe, banga kuza.

4.text: Arongera atuma abandi bagaragu ati ‘Mubwire abatowe muti: Dore niteguye amazimano, amapfizi yanjye n'inka zibyibushye babibāze, byose byiteguwe, muze mu bukwe.’

5.text: “Maze abo ntibabyitaho barigendera, umwe ajya mu gikingi cye, undi ajya mu rutundo rwe,

6.text: abasigaye bafata abagaragu be barabashinyagurira, barabica.

7.text: Maze umwami ararakara agaba ingabo ze, arimbura abo bicanyi atwika umudugudu wabo.

8.text: Maze abwira abagaragu be ati ‘Ubukwe bwiteguwe, ariko abari babutorewe ntibari babukwiriye.

9.text: Nuko mujye mu nzira nyabagendwa, abo muri buboneyo bose mubahamagare baze batahe ubukwe.’

10.text: Abo bagaragu barasohoka bajya mu nzira, bateranya abo babonye bose, ababi n'abeza, inzu yo gucyurizamo ubukwe yuzura abasangwa.

11.text: “Umwami yinjiye kureba abasangwa, abonamo umuntu utambaye umwenda w'ubukwe.

12.text: Aramubaza ati ‘Mugenzi wanjye, ni iki gitumye winjira hano utambaye umwenda w'ubukwe?’ Na we arahora rwose.

13.text: Maze umwami abwira abagaragu be ati ‘Nimumubohe amaboko n'amaguru, mumujugunye mu mwijima hanze, ni ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo’,

14.text: kuko abatowe ari benshi, ariko abatoranyijwe bakaba bake.”

15.text: Maze Abafarisayo baragenda bajya inama y'uko bari bumutegeshe amagambo.

16.text: Bamutumaho abigishwa babo hamwe n'Abaherode bati “Mwigisha, tuzi yuko uri inyangamugayo kandi ko wigisha inzira y'Imana by'ukuri, nturobanura abantu ku butoni, kuko utita ku cyubahiro cy'umuntu wese.

17.text: Nuko tubwire, utekereza ute? Amategeko yemera ko duha Kayisari umusoro, cyangwa ntiyemera?”

18.text: Ariko Yesu amenya uburiganya bwabo, arababaza ati “Mungeragereje iki, mwa ndyarya mwe?

20.text: Arababaza ati “Iyi shusho n'iri zina ni ibya nde?”

21.text: Baramusubiza bati “Ni ibya Kayisari.”Maze arababwira ati “Nuko rero ibya Kayisari mubihe Kayisari, iby'Imana mubihe Imana.”

23.text: Uwo munsi Abasadukayo bahakanaga yuko ari nta wuzuka, baza aho ari baramubaza bati

24.text: “Mwigisha, Mose yaravuze ngo umuntu napfa batarabyarana, mwene se nahungure umugore we acikure mwene se.

25.text: Nuko iwacu habayeho abavandimwe barindwi, uwa mbere yararongoye arapfa, maze kuko batabyaranye araga mwene se umugore we.

26.text: Nuko n'uwa kabiri n'uwa gatatu kugeza kuri bose uko ari barindwi bamera batyo.

27.text: Hanyuma wa mugore na we arapfa.

28.text: Mbese mu izuka, azaba ari muka nde muri bose uko ari barindwi, ko bose bari bamufite?”

29.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Mwarahabye kuko mutamenye ibyanditswe cyangwa imbaraga z'Imana.

30.text: Mu izuka ntibarongora kandi ntibashyingirwa, ahubwo bamera nk'abamarayika bo mu ijuru.

31.text: Ariko se ibyerekeye ku kuzuka kw'abapfuye, ntimwari mwasoma icyo Imana yababwiye ngo

32.text: ‘Ni jye Mana ya Aburahamu n'Imana ya Isaka n'Imana ya Yakobo?’ Imana si Imana y'abapfuye, ahubwo ni iy'abazima.”

33.text: Abantu babyumvise batangazwa no kwigisha kwe.

34.text: Ariko Abafarisayo bumvise yuko yatsinze Abasadukayo, bakananirwa kumusubiza, bateranira hamwe,

35.text: umwe muri bo w'umwigishamategeko amubaza amugerageza ati

36.text: “Mwigisha, itegeko rikomeye mu mategeko ni irihe?”

37.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “ ‘Ukundishe Uwiteka, Imana yawe umutima wawe wose n'ubugingo bwawe bwose n'ubwenge bwawe bwose.’

38.text: Iryo ni ryo tegeko rikomeye ry'imbere.

39.text: N'irya kabiri rihwanye na ryo ngiri ‘Ukunde mugenzi wawe nk'uko wikunda.’

40.text: Muri ayo mategeko yombi, amategeko yose n'ibyahanuwe ni yo yuririraho.”

42.text: “Ibya Kristo murabitekereza mute? Ni mwene nde?”Baramusubiza bati “Ni mwene Dawidi.”

43.text: Arababaza ati “Nuko rero ni iki cyatumye Dawidi yabwirijwe n'Umwuka amwita umwami we ati

44.text: ‘Uwiteka yabwiye Umwami wanjye ati:Icara iburyo bwanjye,Ugeze aho nzashyirira abanzi bawe munsi y'ibirenge byawe.’

45.text: Nuko ubwo Dawidi amwita umwami we, none abasha ate no kuba umwana we?”

46.text: Ntihagira umuntu wabasha kumusubiza ijambo, ndetse uhereye uwo munsi nta muntu watinyutse kongera kugira icyo amubaza.
